title: Fishing rod
wikitext:
{{About|the weapon class|the weapon base type|Fishing Rod}}

'''Fishing rods''' are a rare two-handed melee [[weapon]] class.

__TOC__

==Skills==

There are few [[skill]]s specifically pertaining to fishing rods. Not all skills that are described as working with "all melee weapons" work with fishing rods; this is determined on a case-by-case basis.

==Modifiers and Crafting==

See [[Fishing_Rod#Crafting]].
